basic_details.job_title: NVS Hostel Superintendent Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) has officially released a notification for the recruitment of Hostel Superintendent Posts. This recruitment drive offers a great opportunity for candidates looking for education jobs. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website.

age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 35 years Maximum Age: 62 years Age relaxation details are not specified in the provided data.

qualification.details: Hostel Superintendent: Graduation in any discipline. Minimum 02 years of experience in pay level 3 (Rs. 21700) or above of 7th CPC (or equivalent scale) in any recognized school. OR Ex-defence personnel having experience of minimum 02 years in pay level 3 or above of 7th CPC. Desirable: Master's degree/B.Ed, proficiency in regional language.

salary_details.details: Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 35,750/- per month.

selection_process: Online Application Document Verification Personal Interaction (Physical Mode) Final Merit List preparation
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NVS Hostel Superintendent Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NVS to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NVS Hostel Superintendent recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the NVS Hostel Superintendent recruitment is 03-08-2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Hostel Superintendent post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduation degree in any discipline. Additionally, a minimum of 2 years of experience in pay level 3 or above of the 7th CPC is required, or ex-defence personnel with similar experience are also eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Hostel Superintendent position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Hostel Superintendent post is a minimum of 35 years and a maximum of 62 years. Specific age relaxation rules may apply, which are detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Hostel Superintendent post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Hostel Superintendent post will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 35,750/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for the Hostel Superintendent post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an online application, followed by document verification, a personal interaction in a physical mode, and finally, the preparation of a merit list.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the NVS Hostel Superintendent recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the provided information, no application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the NVS Hostel Superintendent recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the NVS Hostel Superintendent recruitment must be submitted online through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Hostel Superintendent be posted?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti, and the specific locations mentioned are Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand, with the city being Lucknow.

faq.question: Q9. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for the Hostel Superintendent post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Hostel Superintendent post is scheduled to be held on 18-08-2026 and 19-08-2026.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for the NVS Hostel Superintendent recruitment is F.No.6-19(Hos.Sup)/NVS/SA/2026-27/803.
